summary: Fixed both external #224 typed-diff defects in internal/messaging/outbox_typed_diff.go only (46 insertions, 7 deletions). (1) Removals are collected and emitted as one non-overlapping patch per contiguous run, separator chosen relative to the retained neighbour (previous entry end, else next entry start, else array open); CleanupOutbox now removes two leading failed DMs in front of a retained protocol group entry. (2) Relays compared with reflect.DeepEqual (no normalization): legacy nil->[] and []->nil are refused with ErrOutboxTypedWriteHeld and zero writes (bytes and mtime unchanged); a final coverage check refuses any typed change the emitted patches do not express. New tests in outbox_typed_diff_test.go: leading/middle/trailing/adjacent+separated/all-deleted runs with retained protocol (failure_result, recovery_witness) and irregular-whitespace relays:null groups, every retained entry byte-identical; run beside a retained DM value update; CleanupOutbox end to end; relay nil/empty both directions with and without status change; unchanged nil/empty/listed relays still patch and keep their raw token. No typed rewrite of protocol entries; group retry budgets, W1 snapshot guard and W2 runtime untouched.

tests.command: baseline: go test ./internal/messaging -run 'TypedDiff|CleanupOutboxRemovesLeading' -count=1 -v (new tests against base outbox_typed_diff.go)
tests.note: expected failure: 14 FAIL lines (overlapping patch range for leading runs; nil/empty relay changes returned success or silently persisted status only); control cases passed
